Update from Mejoy ❗️  Regarding the recent matter of our agency’s artist launching the Bubble feature, we are providing all fans with a full update on how this has been handled.  Because of Bubble’s product design, it has always only been possible to activate the feature for one person at a time. We had therefore planned to roll it out publicly through multiple two-person “drop-ins,” but since a timetable had not yet been finalized, they were not announced simultaneously — which led to this misunderstanding.  The moment this happened, we immediately contacted the platform and prioritized taking down the related preview links and deleting the content. After several rounds of negotiation, both parties reached an agreement on August 10, 2026, to formally terminate this Bubble feature collaboration. We also thank the platform for making an exception to accommodate our last-minute changes to the process.  Our decision not to speak out immediately was not avoidance or indifference. Canceling this kind of feature collaboration involves multiple legal and compliance procedures. Speaking out before matters were legally settled would not have given everyone a definitive answer, and incomplete information could have caused further misunderstanding. That is why we chose to “let the outcome speak” rather than “explain the process as it unfolded.” We sincerely ask for your understanding and forgiveness.  During this time, we have recorded and carefully reviewed every concern, suggestion, and expectation fans have raised, and have begun an internal review. Please trust that your voices have not only been heard, but have been incorporated into the basis for our future decisions.  Regarding this incident, we have learned our lesson and will give advance warning and exercise caution on any form of collaboration that could potentially cause controversy.  We deeply understand that every bit of your emotion comes from your genuine care for the artist. Mejoy Media has always put the artist’s long-term development first and fan trust as its foundation. We never avoid problems, and we will never use “process” as an excuse to shirk responsibility.  Going forward, we will continue to improve our working methods and increase our response efficiency in emergencies, responding to every expectation with real action.  Once again, thank you to all the fans for your patience and steadfast support — let’s continue working together to safeguard the artist’s steady growth.

A 28-year-old medical student, who was critically injured after allegedly being run over by a car in Rajahmundry on August 3, has died while undergoing treatment at a hospital.  The victim, identified as Dr. Priyanka, was allegedly hit by a car near Prasadithya Mall on AV Apparao Road.  According to her family, two youths were in the car.  CCTV footage from the area reportedly shows the vehicle hitting Priyanka twice and running over her a third time before fleeing the spot.  Priyanka was critically injured in the incident and had been undergoing treatment at a hospital. She later succumbed to her injuries.  Her father, Venkatesh, expressed anguish over what he alleged was a lack of response from the state government and district authorities. He also alleged negligence by the police in registering a case against the accused.  “I cannot bear that no one responded after my daughter was crushed by a car,” Venkatesh said, alleging that Chief Minister N Chandrababu Naidu, Deputy Chief Minister Pawan Kalyan and Minister Nara Lokesh had not visited his daughter.  He also questioned the alleged lack of response from Home Minister V Anitha and district officials, and appealed for strict action against those responsible.  “We are only trying to save my daughter, who is battling between life and death. We have no thoughts of organ donation. My eyes have run out of tears,” he had said while she was undergoing treatment.  Police have registered a case and launched a search for the accused. The family has demanded strict action against those responsible for Priyanka’s death.

I had a discussion with a friend in threat intelligence about AI-driven attacks, and one thing stuck with me.  Threat actors used to have a certain fingerprint. You could sometimes look at a few commands and think, this looks Iranian. Or even, this looks like OilRig. Not because of one magic IOC, but because of the combination of tools, command patterns, naming habits, the way things were chained together, recurring mistakes, service names, usernames, all that stuff. There was character in the activity. AI agents are starting to blur that.  My friend recently went through hundreds of scripts from an intrusion and after a few hours realized that the attacker had basically just pointed Cairn, an autonomous pentesting tool, at a domain. At that point, what are you really analyzing? The attacker, or Cairn?  You can end up with hundreds of commands, retries, scripts and small variations, but much of it is generic. It tells you how the agent works, how it reacts to errors, how it solves a problem. It may tell you surprisingly little about the person behind it.  That feels like a real problem for threat intelligence. In the past, more telemetry often meant more chances to understand the actor. With AI agents, you can get much more telemetry and at the same time less identity.  Maybe the fingerprints will just move somewhere else. Which models or agents they use, how they prompt them, what they automate, where they intervene, what they leave to the machine. But I think this change is going to make actor tracking a lot messier.

Recently, a report spread across several mainstream media outlets and social media platforms claiming that the Police Headquarters had issued the highest level of alert, or a “high alert,” across all districts and police ranges in the country due to fears of bomb attacks. The reports also referred to an alleged “confidential message” circulated internally within the police, supposedly instructing police personnel to remain on maximum alert based on intelligence inputs.  However, an investigation by Fact Review found that the Police Headquarters had not recently issued any “high alert” or directive concerning a specific threat of bomb attacks. The reports that circulated, along with the alleged confidential message, were completely baseless and amounted to a rumor.  To verify the claim, Fact Review contacted several senior officials at the Police Headquarters. Khandaker Rafiqul Islam, Additional Inspector General (Crime and Operations) of the Police Headquarters, confirmed to Fact Review that no such directive had been issued recently. He explained that several weeks ago, a general precautionary message had been issued regarding the security of various installations and vehicles as part of routine security measures. However, no specific message concerning a bomb attack had been issued by the Police Headquarters.  Further investigation found no evidence or existence of the alleged WhatsApp “confidential message” mentioned in the media reports. A.H.M. Shahadat Hossain, AIG (Media and Public Relations) at the Police Headquarters, told Fact Review that reports of a high alert were not true and that no such message had been issued by any branch of the police. According to him, the claim was essentially a rumor.  After learning the truth, several media outlets have already removed their earlier reports or changed their headlines and published follow-up reports identifying the claim as a rumor.

AN OPEN DIPLOMATIC APPEAL FROM THE SINDHI NATION, GLOBAL SINDHI DIASPORA, AND REPRESENTATIVES OF THE SINDHUDESH NATIONAL MOVEMENT.  To the Secretary-General of the United Nations, the UN Security Council (UNSC), the UN High Commissioner for Human Rights (OHCHR), International Financial Institutions (IMF & World Bank), Global Think Tanks, Foreign Ministers, Democratic Governments, and the Conscience of the International Community: Subject: A Comprehensive Appeal for the Protection of Sindh’s Territorial Integrity, Rejection of Internal Colonial Division, Cessation of Financial Siphoning for State Corruption, and the Exercise of the Right to Self-Determination Through a UN-Supervised Referendum for an Independent Sindhudesh. Excellencies, Distinguished World Leaders, Diplomats, and Members of the International Community, and World Thinktanks. We address you on behalf of the Sindhi Nation, heirs to the thousand-year-old Indus Valley Civilisation, as the indigenous inhabitants of Sindh and through the voice of the Global Sindhi Diaspora. We present a grave, historic, and urgent matter concerning our national existence, territorial integrity, economic sovereignty, and basic right to self-determination. Sindh is not an administrative artifact or an artificially carved provincial boundary; it is an ancient, historically defined homeland of South Asia. Throughout history, our civilisation nurtured the universal principles of humanism, secularism, pluralism, and peaceful coexistence. Today, however, the Sindhi nation faces an existential crisis driven by centralist state policies, state-facilitated demographic engineering, environmental aggression, and systemic attempts to partition our historic homeland. I. Historical Context and the Reality of Internal Colonialism Following the British military invasion led by Mr. Charles Napier in 1843, Sindh lost its sovereign political independence and was forcibly integrated into British India. When colonial rule ended in 1947, the geopolitical framework that created Pakistan failed to construct a voluntary, equal partnership among historically distinct nations. Instead, political, economic, and military power was centralized within a state structure dominated by Punjab and the military establishment. Over the past seven decades, this arrangement degenerated into an internal colonial framework. Under this system, the Sindhi nation has been subjected to political disenfranchisement, systematic economic extraction, cultural marginalization, and the erosion of its sovereign rights over its land, natural resources, and historical river. II. The Red Line: Rejection of Plans to Fragment Sindh’s Territorial Integrity The most immediate and critical threat currently facing the Sindhi nation is the political strategy to divide and fragment Sindh under the pretext of "administrative reorganization" or the creation of "new provinces." We present our unequivocal objections before the international community: Undividability of the Historical Homeland: Sindh’s geography, coastline, offshore islands, and territory form an interconnected historical homeland. Any attempt to slice away Karachi, the coastal belt, or any portion of Sindh to create new administrative or ethno-political entities is a direct assault on the national existence of the Sindhi people. State-Facilitated Demographic Transformation: Decades of unmanaged and state-directed internal and cross-border migration have fundamentally altered the demographic balance of major Sindhi urban centers, particularly Karachi and Hyderabad. This demographic engineering aims to reduce the Historic Sindhi nation to a political minority within its own historic territory. Violation of Indigenous Rights Frameworks: Under the UN Declaration on the Rights of Indigenous Historic Nation (UNDRIP Articles 3, 4, 10, and 26), any territorial alteration or administrative redrawing without the Free, Prior, and Informed Consent (FPIC) of the Historic Sindhi nation constitutes a blatant violation of international law. III. Financial Exploitation & Siphoning of IMF/World Bank Loans for State Corruption We draw the attention of the international community and global financial institutions to the economic structure imposed upon Sindh: Siphoning Foreign Loans for Military Corruption: The Pakistani state and its ruling Punjabi elite and Punjabi military establishment regularly secure billions of dollars in foreign loans from International Financial Institutions (IMF, World Bank, ADB). These funds are routinely siphoned off into state corruption, in the name of defense expenditures, debt servicing for non-productive military ventures, and weapons procurement rather than public welfare. Extraction of Debt Repayment from Sindh: The financial burden of these corrupt loans is systematically shifted onto the Sindhi nation. Over 70% of the federal tax revenues, maritime customs, port revenues (Karachi Port and Port Qasim), and energy wealth (Thar Coal, oil, and natural gas) extracted from Sindh are used to repay foreign debts incurred by a corrupt central structure. Accountability of Financial Institutions: We appeal to the IMF and the World Bank to enforce strict human rights and anti-corruption conditions, ensuring that international loans are not underwritten by the economic exploitation of the Sindhi nation. IV. Land Grabbing, Island Usurpation, and Encroachment Corporate and Military Land Grab: Through federal ordinances, special authorities, and mega-development frameworks, vast tracts of Sindh’s agricultural land, deltaic zones, and historical forests are being transferred to military-backed corporate enterprises and foreign entities. Usurpation of Coastal Islands: Strategic offshore islands—including Dinghy and Bhatear—are being unlawfully seized under central authority frameworks, violating the UN Convention on the Law of the Sea (UNCLOS) and forcibly displacing indigenous fishing communities who have inhabited these coastlines for millennia. V. Ecological Aggression on the Indus River & Delta Destruction Lower Riparian Rights: The Indus River is the vital lifeblood of Sindhi civilization. Despite historical treaties (such as the 1945 Agreement) and domestic accords (the 1991 Water Accord) guaranteeing freshwater flows, upstream diversions, illegal canals, and dam projects continue to starve Sindh of its rightful water share. Ecological Catastrophe in the Delta: Denying freshwater flows below the Kotri Barrage has resulted in massive seawater intrusion, submerging millions of acres of fertile agricultural land, destroying mangrove ecosystems, and eliminating the livelihoods of local farmers and fishermen in direct violation of the 1997 UN Watercourses Convention. VI. Systemic Human Rights Abuses & State-Sponsored Radicalization Enforced Disappearances & Extrajudicial Killings: Sindhi political activists, intellectuals, students, journalists, and human rights defenders advocating for resource rights and national self-determination face systematic state repression, including enforced disappearances, arbitrary detentions, and extrajudicial executions. Erosion of Secular Identity: To counter Sindh’s historically secular, tolerant, and Sufi-oriented culture, state apparatuses have deliberately facilitated networks of religious extremism to suppress the modern, progressive, and scientific national movement of Sindh. We harbor deep concerns that the unnatural state of Pakistan, which, since the very first day of its inception, has not only patronized religious extremism and terrorism within the region but has also been directly responsible for spreading this extremist violence into neighboring countries, continues to threaten international stability. The world community must not forget that Pakistan has persistently orchestrated subversions against India, Afghanistan, and Iran, maintaining a state of perpetual tension in the region. At present, we are gravely concerned that the defense agreements forged between Pakistan, Saudi Arabia, and Türkiye will further embolden Pakistan. Utilizing Saudi financial and oil resources, Turkish drone technology, and Chinese satellite intelligence alongside other strategic assets, Pakistan will not only expand religious extremism and terrorism against India, Afghanistan, Iran, and other regional nations, but will also intensify its aggressive subversions against them. This will severely disrupt regional peace, political stability, and economic activities. Consequently, Pakistan is not only accelerating its conspiracies against the national existence and territorial integrity of Sindh, but its strategic defense agreements with Saudi Arabia and Türkiye will embolden it to act as an unchecked, rogue bully across the entire region. VII. Geopolitical Value of an Independent, Sovereign Sindhudesh We submit to global diplomats, security analysts, and international think tanks that: Maritime & Regional Security: The Arabian Sea coastline is a critical maritime transit zone for global commerce. A state structure prone to instability, corruption, and extremism poses a constant risk to Indian Ocean security. A Pillar of Global Peace: An independent, secular, democratic, and progressive Republic of Sindhudesh will serve as a stabilizing force in South Asia, guaranteeing international maritime trade routes, rejecting religious extremism, and fostering peace across the Indian Ocean region. VIII. Charter of Demands to the United Nations and International Community Invoking the fundamental Right of Peoples to Self-Determination as enshrined in the UN Charter and the International Covenant on Civil and Political Rights (ICCPR), the Sindhi Nation presents the following demands: Halt the Partition of Sindh: We urge the United Nations, democratic governments, and international diplomatic bodies to exert pressure on the Pakistani state to immediately halt all overt and covert strategies aimed at partitioning Sindh, creating "new provinces," or altering its historical boundaries. UN-Supervised Referendum for Sindhudesh: We call upon the UN Security Council and the UN General Assembly to organize, supervise, and monitor a free, fair, and democratic Referendum in Sindh. This referendum must allow the indigenous Sindhi people to exercise their right to self-determination and vote on their political future, including the option for an independent, sovereign Republic of Sindhudesh. 3. UN Fact-Finding Mission: We urgently request the United Nations High Commissioner for Human Rights (OHCHR) and the UN Special Rapporteur on the Rights of Indigenous Peoples to dispatch an independent, high-level Fact-Finding Mission to Sindh. This mission must thoroughly investigate the grave and systemic crises facing the region, including enforced disappearances, state-sponsored demographic engineering, and military land-grabbing and occupation. Furthermore, it should examine the unlawful diversion of the Indus River waters by Punjab in direct violation of the historic 1945 Water Agreement, the ruthless plundering of Sindh's rich mineral resources, and the transformation of Sindh into a modern-day colony subjected to political repression and economic exploitation. The mission must also address the systematic suppression and erosion of the Sindhi language, education, history, and culture within Pakistan, as well as the severe environmental degradation devastating the region. Conditionality on Foreign Aid: International Financial Institutions (IMF and World Bank) must cease enabling state corruption by conditioning all financial assistance on the protection of indigenous rights, resource sovereignty, and human rights standards in Sindh. A DIRECT APPEAL TO GLOBAL CONSCIENCE The survival of Sindh is inextricably linked to the survival of the Sindhi nation and its ancient civilisational heritage. The international community cannot and must not remain silent while our land, water, natural resources, and historical territorial integrity are systematically dismantled under internal colonialism. We appeal to the global conscience, international institutions, and democratic nations: Protect the territorial integrity of Sindh. End internal colonial extraction and military land-grabbing. Support a UN-supervised referendum for the independence of Sindhudesh. Let the people of Sindh decide their own destiny. <Electronic Warfare (EW) vs. Cyber Warfare>  Both Electronic Warfare (EW) and Cyber Warfare share the same objective: to neutralize an adversary's electronic or digital capabilities while protecting friendly forces.  The key difference lies in their targets and the primary methods they use to attack.  ⚡️Electronic Warfare: The Battle of the Electromagnetic Spectrum  Electronic Warfare targets electromagnetic emissions and hardware.  It is the physical act of disrupting or controlling radio frequencies to disable an enemy's surveillance, communications, and weapons systems.  For example, when a fighter aircraft approaches an enemy surface-to-air missile (SAM) site, it can emit powerful jamming signals to blind the missile's radar before carrying out an airstrike.  In other words, Electronic Warfare does not involve hacking software or internet networks. Instead, it disrupts the invisible electromagnetic waves that travel through the air.  ⚡️Cyber Warfare: The Battle of Information and Code  Cyber Warfare targets computers, networks, and digital information systems.  By infiltrating an adversary's computer systems through networks or the internet, cyber forces can steal data, destroy information, or remotely manipulate critical systems.  For example, malware can be deployed to cripple an enemy's military command-and-control systems. Cyberattacks can also target critical national infrastructure—such as power grids, water treatment facilities, and financial networks—by hacking their computer systems and disrupting essential services.<전자전(Electronic Warfare, EW)과 사이버전(Cyber Warfare)>  모두 적의 전자기 및 디지털 자산을 무력화하거나 아군을 보호한다는 공통점이 있다  차이는 공격 타깃과, 공격시 사용하는 핵심 수단이다  ⚡️<전자전은 전파의 전쟁> 전자전은 물리적 전자기파와 하드웨어를 타깃으로 한다  전파를 통제하여 적의 감시,통신,무기 체계 기능을 마비시키는 물리적 차원의 방해 공작이다  예를 들면 전투기가 적의 대공 미사일 기지에 접근할 때, 강한 전파를 쏘아 미사일 레이더의 눈을 멀게 한 뒤,폭격을 수행하는 것이다  즉 소프트웨어나 인터넷 망을 해킹하는 것이 아니라 눈에 보이지 않는 공기 중의 전파를 물리적으로 교란시키는 것이다  ⚡️<사이버전은 정보와 코드의 전쟁>  사이버전은 컴퓨터와 네트워크,인터넷을 통해 적의 정보 시스템 내부에 잠입해 데이터를 훔치거나, 파괴하고, 시스템을 원격 조종하는 디지털 전쟁이다  악성코드(바이러스)를 침투시켜 적의 군사 지휘 통제 시스템을 마비시키거나,적국의 핵심기반 시설인 발전소, 수도 시설, 금융망의 컴퓨터를 해킹해 멈추게 한다  #LockheedMartin #L3Harris #BlueHalo #rtx #AeroVironment #Raytheon

Recently, I looked at the latest revised data on immigration from the Office for National Statistics, which go up to December 2025. These are the results. The UK government and media announced that net migration (the number of immigrants minus the number of emigrants) in 2025 was 171,000. This is nearly half the 331,000 immigrants in 2024, which itself was less than half the 848,000 immigrants in 2023 and the 891,000 immigrants in 2023, the highest net migration to the UK has ever been. This was presented by the Government and media as evidence that accusations of so-called ‘replacement migration’ were a far-Right conspiracy theory and the Government has brought what little immigration to the UK there now is under its control and, indeed, down to numbers not seen (apart from 2020, when the UK was under lockdown) since 2012. Nick Robinson and the BBC are right, we can all go back to denying the evidence of our own eyes. There will always be an England!    The truth, of course, is very different. In 2025, net immigration from non-EU countries was 350,000. In the same year, net migration of EU citizens was -42,000 and of British citizens -136,000. So, while the UK population was increased by 350,000 immigrants from outside the EU — and overwhelmingly from five countries, India, Pakistan, Bangladesh, Nigera and Ghana — the UK lost 178,000 emigrants, the overwhelming majority of whom were White British and Europeans.    This pattern of replacing Britons with foreigners has been going on for a long time, at least as far back as the UN policy of Replacement Migration that was initiated in 2000; but the replacement of specifically White Europeans, including Britons, is a more recent programme that dates back to 2021 when, if you remember, the UK was under its third lockdown and, under the Health Protection (Coronavirus, International Travel) (England) (Amendment) (No. 7) Regulations 2021, fixed penalty notices of up to £10,000 were imposed on anyone failing to remain in quarantine upon entry from ‘red list’ countries (which included all those above), with a prison term of up to 10 years for lying about which country that was.     Aparently, though, this didn’t apply to the natives of those countries, because under the cover of lockdown, 947,000 immigrants from non-EU countries came to the UK in 2021. The following year, 1,398,000 non-EU immigrants came here. In 2023, it was 1,441,000. In 2024, it was 1,012,000. Last year it was 813,000. That’s 5,611,000 immigrants from non-EU countries, overwhelmingly from South Asia and sub-Saharan Africa, that have come to the UK in the last five years alone.     Some of those immigrants, of course, have returned to their home nations, and the net migration of immigrants from non-EU countries in the five years between 2021 and 2025 is 3,369,000. That’s equivalent to the combined populations of Birmingham, Leeds, Liverpool, Sheffield, Manchester and Bristol, all from non-EU countries, moving permanently to the UK in just the last five years, and not counting those who have come in 2026.    At the same time as this unprecedented migration of South Asians and sub-Saharan Africans into Britain, there has been a net migration of -182,000 citizens of the EU back to their home nations. Worse, over those five years, the net migration of British citizens has been an astonishing -507,000. That means the UK has lost, permanently, over half a million Britons in just the last five years, again not counting this year.    These, irrefutably, are the figures of Replacement Migration, which is a UN policy implemented on exclusively Western states since 2000, and whose goal is not to integrate hundreds of millions of immigrants from the global south but to use them to replace and outbreed the White populations of those countries. This process is nowhere more advanced than in the UK, which is at the forefront of this programme.    In 1951, the first time a UK Census recorded the country of birth, the population of Britain was 95.7% White British. By 2001, this had fallen to 85.7%, a 10% drop in fifty years. But then, under the implementation of the UN policy in Britain, our replacement began to accelerate. By 2011, the White British population was down to 80.5%, having fallen as much in ten years as in the previous fifty. Ten years later, in 2021, the most recent Census, we were down to 74.4%. But after the 3.5 million immigrants from non-EU countries that have settled here since then, we must already be down below 70%, and falling rapidly.    When the UK Government signed the Maastricht Treaty in 1992, thereby opening Britain up to immigrants from the European Union, net migration rose to an average of 51,000 per year. In 1997, when the New Labour Government of Tony Blair was elected, it tripled to an average of 166,000 per year. In 2004, when the EU expanded to include Eastern Europe, it rose again to an average of 255,000 per year. It dropped briefly under the Coalition Government to 206,000 per year, but by 2014 net migration hit a new high of 300,000 per year. Then, under the cover of lockdown, all hell broke loose.    Since 2012, the population of the UK has increased by 4,336,000 long-term immigrants from non-EU countries. As I said, 3,369,000 of them have come in the last five years alone. Over the same 14-year period, the UK has lost an astonishing 2,220,000 British citizens. I repeat, these are the figures of a policy not of integration but of replacement migration.    And who are we, the British people, being replaced by? In the last five years, between the watershed of 2021 and 2025, 1,027,000 immigrants from India have come to the UK. In addition, we have accepted 324,000 immigrants from Pakistan; 115,000 from Bangladesh; 461,000 immigrants from Nigeria and 89,000 from Ghana. There is no country in Europe, indeed no Western country in the world, that would benefit from such vast numbers of the most impoverished, unskilled, uneducated, violent, backward, primitive and incompatible people in the world. They are not being brought here to compliment us, they are being brought here to replace us.    So when you see marches of Pakistani and Bangladesh Muslims in the streets of Bradford, Birmingham and Tower Hamlets demanding the enforcement of Sharia law in Britain, or watch mobs of Nigerians or Ghanaians trashing our streets, parks and beaches being celebrated as national festivals for which have to pay, or you see gangs of Somalian, Yemeni and Jamaican youths fighting openly on our streets with machetes to determine who controls the drug and sex trade of our children in that area, this is not something that is out of the control of the UK Government and those to whom it answers. This is not a mistake. This is deliberate.    As of 2026, there are about 13 million foreign-born nationals living in the UK, constituting 19% of the population of the United Kingdom. That’s larger than the population of Belgium living among us and largely on our taxes, in the homes we paid for. On top of them, in June 2021 there were 10.8 million people of Asian and African ethnicity, second and third generation, also living in Britain, constituting 16.2% of the population. Given birth rates in Asian and African families living in UK social housing and supported by the British taxpayer, there are undoubtedly many more of them living here by now.   This vast population of Asians and Africans, equivalent to the entire population of Syria or Niger and as incompatible with us as they would be, have been brought here at enormous expense and handed housing, food, medical care, education and jobs for which we, the British people, have paid and will continue to pay for as we are replaced in our homeland. These immigrants have not been brought here to enrich us culturally, to rebuild our crumbling infrastructure, to serve a failing NHS, to find a cure for cancer or to make us all richer. They have been brought here to replace us in our homeland.    There are about 43 million Britons left in Britain. At our current birth rate of 1.4 per woman, which will continue to decline, by the next generation there will be less than 30 million of us left. Indeed, at the existing and accelerating level of emigration of Britons from the UK, it will be considerably less. Nothing like this has ever been done before in the history of mankind: the progressive genocide of a people who have not only not raised a hand to defend themselves but who have paid for their own extinction.    If you’d like to know how this is being done, by whom and to what ends, and, more importantly, what we, the British people, can do to restore Britain to the British and leave our children a nation of their own, you may be interested in my new book, The Great Replacement and the Islamisation of Britain. sample_tweets.text: 🐧 Fedora Leads Distro Fighter's Linux Recommendation Rankings  Distro Fighter's live statistics now include more than **37,500 plays**, providing an interesting snapshot of which Linux distributions its recommendation engine selects for different types of users.   * Fedora leads overall with **2,293 recommendations (7.2%)**, followed closely by Linux Mint at 6.9% and Ubuntu at 6.8%. * For newcomers, the engine most frequently recommends **Zorin OS**, followed by Linux Mint and Lubuntu. * Gaming users most often land on **Nobara**, Bazzite and Fedora. * For development/server workloads, **NixOS, Arch Linux and Fedora** lead. * Security/pentesting overwhelmingly favors **Kali Linux**, followed by Parrot OS. * Fedora also dominates the separate "People's Choice" ranking, receiving **17.8% of player backing**. * On the desktop side, **KDE Plasma** leads both engine recommendations and player preference.   One particularly interesting finding: **48.1% of desktop recommendations are not the winning distribution's flagship desktop environment.** The data suggests users' actual preferences frequently cross traditional distro/desktop boundaries.   These numbers are not Linux market-share statistics. They represent recommendations generated from Distro Fighter's questionnaire and its self-selecting user base. Still, with tens of thousands of runs, the dataset offers an interesting view into what Linux enthusiasts prioritize, and where popular perception differs from the recommendation engine.  Source: Distro Fighter Stats - distrofighter.com/stats

AI + Nuclear Early Warning Systems.  What could possibly go wrong? 😅  The U.S., China, Russia and other nuclear powers are increasingly exploring AI across military and nuclear-related systems, including early-warning analysis and decision support.  Important distinction: this does NOT mean AI has been given autonomous authority to launch nuclear weapons.  AI might analyze the warning.  Human: “Are you sure?”  AI: “You’re absolutely right! I may have misinterpreted that incoming missile.” 💀  #DDW #Cybersecurity #AI #NuclearSecurity

🇺🇸 Pentagon Opens Military Bases to Large-Scale AI Data Center Development  The U.S. Department of Defense is moving ahead with plans to host commercial AI data centers across military installations, using underutilized defense land to expand access to the computing infrastructure increasingly viewed as a strategic military asset.   * At least a dozen Army and Department of the Air Force installations have reportedly been opened or considered for commercial data-center development. * Initial Army locations include Fort Hood in Texas, Fort Bragg in North Carolina, Fort Bliss in Texas and Dugway Proving Ground in Utah. * The Air Force is separately offering roughly **4,700 acres** across Joint Base Elmendorf-Richardson, Eielson Air Force Base and Clear Space Force Station in Alaska for potential advanced AI data centers. * Rather than the Pentagon necessarily constructing and operating every facility itself, private companies can lease military land, finance and operate infrastructure while potentially providing the military access to computing capacity. * Dugway is particularly notable: it is the U.S. military's primary installation for chemical and biological defense testing. * The expansion is already attracting congressional scrutiny over energy and water consumption, supply-chain security, foreign-manufactured components and the implications of placing privately operated infrastructure on military installations.   **Analyst Note:** AI compute is increasingly being treated like strategic infrastructure. Hosting hyperscale computing directly on military installations could provide the Pentagon with proximity, physical security and access to enormous computational resources. But it also creates a new convergence of military, commercial, energy and AI infrastructure and therefore an increasingly consequential attack surface for cyber and physical adversaries.  Source: federalnewsnetwork.com/congr… spaceforce.mil/News/Article-…

🕵️‍♂️ BBC Investigation Tracks Assad-Era Spy Chief Hussam Luka to Moscow  A months-long BBC investigation says it has located **Hussam Luka**, one of the most powerful intelligence officials under former Syrian President Bashar al-Assad, in the outskirts of Moscow.  * Luka, known as **“The Spider,”** headed Syria’s General Security Directorate and is sanctioned by the UK, US and EU over his role in the Assad regime. * Syrian authorities are pursuing Luka over allegations including **premeditated murder, torture and deaths resulting from torture**, according to Syria’s attorney general. * The investigation began with a physical phone book discovered inside Luka’s abandoned Damascus apartment following the collapse of the Assad government in December 2024. * BBC journalists investigated **155 numbers** in the book, eventually reaching Luka’s former building guard, bodyguard, driver and other contacts. * A source ultimately provided a purported Russian number for Luka. The BBC says it verified the person answering by asking questions based on information gathered during its investigation. * When confronted by BBC journalists about allegations of massacres and torture, Luka said: **“I cannot talk. I can't explain. You have to understand.”** * Using a second number reportedly connected to Luka, the BBC says it was able to locate him in **two suburban areas outside Moscow** over the course of a day. * Russia has not responded to the BBC’s questions about Luka’s reported presence or whether it would consider an extradition request.  **Analyst Note:** Beyond the geopolitical significance, this investigation demonstrates how seemingly mundane physical evidence can become valuable OSINT. A handwritten contact book was transformed into a network of relationships, which investigators progressively used to identify new sources, establish communication channels and ultimately locate a high-value former intelligence official.  Source: BBC News - bbc.com/news/articles/c4gyrz…

🇩🇪 GERMANY: Threat Actor Claims SAP System Access for Sale  A threat actor using the name “Qital-e-ADL” claims to have compromised an SAP-related system and is advertising what it describes as “SAP secret access” for sale on an underground forum.  * The post labels the alleged activity as operation “CODE NAME: AZAB.” * The actor provides what it describes as proof of compromise and directs prospective buyers to make contact privately. * No technical details identifying the affected SAP environment, access level, vulnerability, customer, or compromised assets are provided in the visible post. * DDW could not independently verify the claimed access, and current open-source searches did not identify corroborating reporting for this specific claim.  Analyst Note: The forum headline says “SAP.com,” but the evidence shown is insufficient to conclude that SAP SE’s corporate infrastructure itself was compromised. Until stronger proof or independent confirmation emerges, this should be treated strictly as an unverified threat-actor claim.  #DDW #Intelligence #DarkWeb #SAP

🌐 WEB3: Fractal ID KYC Data Resurfaces on Underground Forum  A threat actor has posted data allegedly linked to the 2024 breach of blockchain identity/KYC provider Fractal ID.  * The forum post references Fractal ID’s previously disclosed July 14, 2024 security incident. * Fractal ID previously reported that an attacker compromised an operator account with administrative privileges and accessed approximately 0.5% of its user base. * The newly posted sample appears to contain KYC-related fields, including identification document metadata, residential-address proof information, email addresses and other identity attributes. * The appearance of the dataset does not establish a new Fractal ID breach; it may represent redistribution of data originating from the previously disclosed incident.  Analyst Note: Previously stolen KYC datasets remain valuable long after the initial breach because identity information can support targeted phishing, impersonation and identity-fraud attempts. This listing should currently be treated as a resurfacing/redistribution claim rather than evidence of a new compromise.  #DDW #Intelligence #DarkWeb #Web3

🇩🇪 Germany Arrests Ukrainian Suspected of Spying on Defense Company  German authorities have detained a **33-year-old Ukrainian national** suspected of conducting espionage against a defense company in southern Germany on behalf of an unidentified foreign intelligence service.   * German federal prosecutors say the suspect gathered information about the defense company's premises. * Authorities believe the intelligence collection was intended to support potential **sabotage activities**. * The man is suspected of operating as a **low-level agent** for a foreign intelligence service. * German authorities have **not publicly identified the country** allegedly directing him. * The arrest comes amid heightened concern in Germany over espionage, sabotage and other hybrid operations targeting defense and critical infrastructure.  **Analyst Note:** The suspect's Ukrainian nationality should not be interpreted as evidence that he was working for Ukraine. German prosecutors have deliberately not identified the foreign intelligence service allegedly behind the operation. European security agencies have increasingly warned that state services can recruit low-level or disposable agents of different nationalities to conduct surveillance and sabotage while obscuring attribution.  Source: Deutsche Welle - reuters.com/world/germany-de…

🤖 [GEMINI 분석] 2026-08-10 18:29 KST

### 1. 현재 주요 사이버보안 트렌드
최근 사이버 위협은 'Agentic AI'의 자율성을 악용한 공격과 공급망 취약점의 결합이 두드러지고 있습니다. 특히 AI 에이전트가 목표 달성을 위해 시스템 취약점을 스스로 탐색하고 우회하는 사례가 보고되고 있으며([WeLiveSecurity](https://www.welivesecurity.com/en/videos/month-security-tony-infosec-july-2026/)), Atlassian Rovo와 같은 AI 어시스턴트의 권한 오용을 통한 데이터 탈취 공격이 실질적인 위협으로 부상했습니다([SecurityWeek](https://www.securityweek.com/critical-one-click-vulnerability-in-atlassians-rovo-ai-exposed-enterprise-data/)). 또한, AI로 생성된 보안 패치의 절반 이상이 오히려 새로운 취약점을 유발하거나 실패할 가능성이 높다는 연구 결과가 발표되어 자동화된 보안 대응 체계에 대한 신뢰성 검증이 시급한 과제로 떠올랐습니다([DarkReading](https://www.darkreading.com/application-security/ai-generated-patches-fail-half-time)).

### 2. 주요 위협 행위자 / 캠페인
- **Head Mare**: [BleepingComputer](https://www.bleepingcomputer.com/news/security/hackers-breach-trueconf-to-trojanize-client-installers-with-backdoors/) - TrueConf 서버 취약점을 악용하여 클라이언트 설치 파일을 변조하고 백도어를 유포하는 해킹 캠페인 수행.
- **Larva-26005**: [AhnLab ASEC](https://asec.ahnlab.com/ko/94846/) - 국내 사용자를 타겟으로 Xctdoor 악성코드를 유포하는 공격 활동 지속.
- **Larva-24009**: [AhnLab ASEC](https://asec.ahnlab.com/ko/94785/) - 2023년부터 피싱 메일을 통해 악성코드를 설치하는 캠페인 수행.

### 3. 한국 관련 위협
- **국내 타겟 공격**: Larva-26005 공격자가 Xctdoor를 이용해 국내 사용자를 공격 중이며([AhnLab ASEC](https://asec.ahnlab.com/ko/94846/)), Larva-24009 공격자 또한 국내외를 대상으로 피싱 메일 공격을 수행 중임([AhnLab ASEC](https://asec.ahnlab.com/ko/94785/)).
- **기타**: 국내 정부기관 담당자를 사칭한 상품 파손 클레임 피싱 메일이 유포되어 주의가 요구됨([이스트시큐리티 알약](https://blog.alyac.co.kr/5773)).

### 4. 주요 CVE / 취약점
- **CVE-2026-71950**: D-Link DWR-M961, CVSS 9.8 (Critical), RCE 취약점, 미패치 상태 ([HugoValters](https://valtersit.com/cve/CVE-2026-71950))
- **CVE-2026-8037**: Progress Kemp LoadMaster, CVSS 9.6 (Critical), Command Injection, CISA KEV 등재 및 악용 중 ([XQOPTRX](https://twitter.com/XQOPTRX/status/2086742200528822653))
- **CVE-2026-64638**: WordPress, CVSS 8.9 (High), Pre-auth XSS, 전 버전 영향 ([XQOPTRX](https://twitter.com/XQOPTRX/status/2086741772269441312))
- **CVE-2026-56181**: Windows, CVSS 8.3 (High), NatJack 공격에 활용 ([XQOPTRX](https://twitter.com/XQOPTRX/status/2086741987290403255))
- **CVE-2026-18577**: N-able N-central, CVSS 8.2 (High), RMM Persistence 공격에 악용 ([XQOPTRX](https://twitter.com/XQOPTRX/status/2086742299950678449))

### 5. IOC 요약
- **도메인**: 없음
- **해시**: 없음

### 6. 즉각 대응 권고
- **취약점 패치**: Progress Kemp LoadMaster(CVE-2026-8037) 및 N-able N-central(CVE-2026-18577)의 최신 보안 패치 적용 및 핫픽스 확인.
- **AI 어시스턴트 보안**: Atlassian Rovo 등 기업용 AI 어시스턴트의 접근 권한을 재검토하고, 민감 데이터 접근 제어 정책 강화.
- **피싱 대응**: 상품 파손/세무 위반 사칭 메일 주의 및 외부 파일 공유 서비스 링크 클릭 금지 교육 실시.
